theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' :=
  fun u i => ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength i) (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined i) u) $ InitStatesNodup i, by
    simp only [InitStatesUpdated i, UpdateStatesUpdated u]
    unfold updatedStates
    rw [updatedStatesComm]
    exact updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength u) $ updatedStatesDefMonotone $ UpdateStatesDefined' u
    simp only [List.unzip_zip $ UpdateStatesLength u, List.unzip_zip $ InitStatesLength i]
    exact fun _ a b => absurd (UpdateStatesDefined u _ a) $ InitStatesNotDefined i _ b ▸ Bool.false_ne_true⟩

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  have Hlen1 := InitStatesLength Hinit
  have Hlen2 := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  have Hdisj : List.Disjoint ks ks' := by
    intro x hx hx'
    have h : (σ' x).isSome = true := UpdateStatesDefined Hup x hx
    rw [InitStatesNotDefined Hinit x hx'] at h
    cases h
  have Hdisj' : (ks.zip vs).unzip.1.Disjoint (ks'.zip vs').unzip.1 := by
    rw [List.unzip_zip_left (Nat.le_of_eq Hlen2),
        List.unzip_zip_left (Nat.le_of_eq Hlen1)]
    exact Hdisj
  have Hσ : σ'' = updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs := by
    rw [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup]
    exact updatedStatesComm Hdisj'
  refine ⟨updatedStates σ ks' vs', rfl,
    updatedStatesInit Hlen1
      (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup)
      (InitStatesNodup Hinit), ?_⟩
  rw [Hσ]
  exact updatedStatesUpdate Hlen2
    (updatedStatesDefMonotone (ves := ks'.zip vs') (UpdateStatesDefined' Hup))
